events.text: Could you make three different logo options for my cycling club? I’m excited to see some ideas because I’ve been having trouble picturing what would feel right for the club. The name is Moss & Mile, and each option should include that exact wording, including the ampersand, with no extra text, plus a small symbol. I’d like three separate square images at 640 × 640 px each, not a collage or contact sheet. Please keep the logos simple, using green and black on white. The symbols and fonts are your call, but I do mean three genuinely different symbol or layout concepts rather than just recolors of the same design.
